narr: A main low pressure centered over southeastern Idaho had several shortwaves rotating around the base of the low and cross through Arizona. This brought showers and thunderstorms over portions of northern Arizona.
ev: The river gauge on Havasu creek near the Colorado River rose 6.7 feet in 15 minutes between 1130 and 1145 PM MST. The river gauge is below/downstream from the Village of Supai. The flood damaged all six bridges in and around Supai Village, some of which were a total loss. The main foot and mule trail to the village was damaged and in need of repair. This 8 mile trail is the only way to the village from a road other than by helicopter.
lsr: THE RIVER GAGE ON HAVASU CREEK NEAR SUPAI ROSE 6.7 FEET IN 15 MINS BETWEEN 11:30-11:45 PM MST.
